video_title: Tracy Morgan Joins To Discuss New York's First Championship In 53 Years

quotes.speaker: Tracy Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy Morgan on the Knicks' championship drought and future outlook
quotes.excerpt: It's been 53 years, but the Knicks are coming back, baby. We are building something special.
quotes.quote: It's been 53 years, but the Knicks are coming back, baby. We are building something special. The energy in the city is different. You can feel it in the streets, in the garden, everywhere. We're not just playing; we're competing for that ring.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins on Jalen Brunson's MVP candidacy
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson has played at an MVP level all season. He is the heart of this team.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: When you look at what Jalen Brunson has done this year, it's undeniable. He's carrying that offense every single night.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I agree, Richard. Jalen Brunson has played at an MVP level all season. He is the heart of this team, and without him, they aren't in this position.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the Knicks' defensive intensity in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: This team's defensive intensity is what separates them from the rest of the pack right now.
quotes.quote: This team's defensive intensity is what separates them from the rest of the pack right now. They are locked in, rotating perfectly, and making life miserable for opposing guards. That's championship-level basketball.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the importance of depth for a deep playoff run
quotes.excerpt: You need more than just your stars. The bench has to step up when it matters most.
quotes.quote: You need more than just your stars. The bench has to step up when it matters most. If you want a deep playoff run, your role players have to be ready to contribute on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the Knicks' championship aspirations and Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is just on another level. That's the kind of run no one was projecting from him.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is just on another level. Look at what he did in Game 5, the closing stretch, the way he got to the rim. That's the kind of run no one was projecting from him this season.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on OG Anunoby's impact and Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: OG got Wemby with the hesi. That's the kind of play that changes the momentum of a game.
quotes.quote: OG got Wemby with the hesi. That's the kind of play that changes the momentum of a game. You see the way he attacked the rim, it's not just about the scoring, it's about the confidence he brings to the Knicks' offense.
